verdict.rationale: The evidence documents event-driven triggers, such as running agents from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail, plus programmatic agent runs via the SDK and API. Nothing shows a native way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. On-demand runs and event triggers are one-off actions, and the SDK is only a developer building block a user could wrap in an external scheduler, so neither counts as recurring-schedule support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
